mission.title: Somatic
mission.description: Keep Imelda Kroller, whose body holds the biological interface program, out of Danielle Wright's reach.

npc.say: Yes, Wright has been using a scan routine of some sort that allows her to access information on the pod system through bluepills, and vice versa; it will be difficult to prevent her discovery of Ms. Kroller. We must extract the program from Ms. Kroller's body as soon as possible.
Normally I'd be cock of the walk with an Agent at my back, but he won't be worth spit if Wright or one of those Accelerator programs shows up.
She's been like that ever since they got her here. I don't know what that program's doing to her, but it isn't normal, that's for damn sure.
Get the coppertop out of here.

phase.briefing:
Operative, we have located the biological interface program inside the physical body of a woman named Imelda Kroller. Danielle Wright has been hunting down and terminating humans in pods near Kroller's in an apparent attempt to capture the program. We have taken Kroller into protective custody. Our task is twofold: prevent Wright from finding Kroller in the simulation, and remove the interface program from Kroller's body.
Agent Pace is standing by with Kroller now. She will provide a situation update.

enter.say: I guess he must mean that the program is in the woman's body in the Real. Weird... And not good, since Wright probably knows the pod system better than anyone--any human, anyway.

talk.say: *Buon giorno*, {player}. We are about to move her to a lab where the interface program will be removed, but already, override programs have been detected not far away. I need you to neutralize those programs while we move Ms. Kroller.
Always wondered what my middle initial "N" stood for; now I know it stands for "Neutralize."

enter.say: Sure wish we had some of those anti-override prototypes Cryptos was testing out the other day. Did you hear about that? I guess there are still a lot of kinks to work out, but apparently they helped...a little.

done.say: Good work. Let's see how they're doing at the lab.

near.say: Crap, it isn't a good day to be in a pod.

phase.briefing: Extraction of the interface program from Ms. Kroller's body is not proceeding as quickly as had been projected. With Wright approaching the lab's vicinity, we have no choice but to evacuate the subject. Report to Agent Pace at the lab.

enter.say:
I don't wanna know what Wright'd do to the lady if she got ahold of her.
No overrides in sight...yet.

talk.say: Please take Ms. Kroller with you immediately.
Son of a--! Override signal, right next to your position! Time to move!

We have been unable to obtain the necessary response from the interface program. It has taken control of Ms. Kroller's somatic nervous system, resisting external stimuli.
Now, you must hurry. Do not worry about me, {player}.

objective.text: Lead Imelda Kroller out of the area
Do not let Imelda Kroller die

near.say: There just isn't enough time to try all the permutations...

phase.briefing: Operative, something is happening. Kroller's pod routines have stopped reporting. Confirm subject's status.

mission.finish:
... Unrequested reinitialization of subject's image by the pod hardware...
Signal is active. Unable to resolve location. Status unknown. P0026:05:0149:081 is not responding.
